Norquetiapine, an active metabolite of quetiapine, has moderate to strong affinity for several muscarinic receptor subtypes. This contributes to anticholinergic adverse reactions when SEROQUEL is used at therapeutic doses, taken concomitantly with other anticholinergic medications, or taken in overdose.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "SEROQUEL should be used with caution in patients with a current diagnosis or prior history of urinary retention, clinically significant prostatic hypertrophy, or constipation."

cite.locator: seção 7.1 Effect of Other Drugs on Quetiapine
cite.quote: Given the primary CNS effects of SEROQUEL, caution should be used when it is taken in combination with other centrally acting drugs. SEROQUEL potentiated the cognitive and motor effects of alcohol in a clinical trial in subjects with selected psychotic disorders, and alcoholic beverages should be limited while taking quetiapine.

cite.quote: In bipolar depression studies (up to 8 weeks), the most commonly observed adverse reactions associated with the use of SEROQUEL (incidence of 5% or greater) and observed at a rate on SEROQUEL at least twice that of placebo were somnolence (57%), dry mouth (44%), dizziness (18%), constipation (10%), and lethargy (5%).
cite.note: Mesma seção, esquizofrenia e mania em monoterapia (análise conjunta): "were somnolence (18%), dizziness (11%), dry mouth (9%), constipation (8%), ALT increased (5%), weight gain (5%), and dyspepsia (5%)."

common_effects.note: Depressão bipolar (estudos de até 8 semanas). Letargia entra como cansaço. Na mania em monoterapia (análise junto com esquizofrenia) aparecem também ganho de peso, dispepsia e aumento de ALT.
